Getfactual.us: The first programme features four bunkers built before World War Two. We begin with the legendary Franzensfeste in today’s northern Italy, a fortress that was never besieged.
The second programme features shelters in the nuclear era in Lithuania, Germany and Albania.
What if Hitler Had Won the War
The documentary addresses the counterfactual question of a Nazi victory in the Second World War and is asking at the same time how history would have evolved without Hitler.
Hatred and the desire for revenge smoldered in the minds of many Germans after the First World War. Many Germans believe that the Jews are the cause of all kinds of problems.
Hitler and his movement seem to be eliminated after his failed putsch on November 9, 1923, the movement is banned, the self-proclaimed leaders are imprisoned.
In the late 1920s, Germany was seething. Social protest turns into a racist and anti-Jewish movement, Hitler and his NSDAP using their anger against the “system” for their own benefits.
After the 1933 parliament fire, President Hindenburg signs a decree that suspends freedom of speech. In mock elections, Hitler secures approval; with terror, he intimi-dates his adversaries.
In October 1934, Hitler's government is firmly in the saddle. The majority of Germans support Hitler's offensive anti-Jewish policy.
At the end of 1939, the German Army has invaded Poland. They are followed closely by the SS (Schutzstaffel) task forces, which have only one mission: To murder the Polish intelligence.
Harrowing testimonials from victims show how in 1944 the SS stepped up the “efficiency” of the death factory at Auschwitz and how the perpetrators documented their “work”.
The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis
"The Royals, the British Aristocracy and the Nazis" presents documents and footage proving the royal family’s and leading British aristocrats’ sympathy for National Socialism.
The Moon Landing and the Nazis
The film "The Moon Landing and the Nazis" documents the involvement of German NASA employees with the Third Reich.

CSI.us: Chasing The Bus. A bus carrying 23 passengers from Los Angeles to Las Vegas crashes less than 40 miles from its destination, killing nine people.
Stalker. Jane Galloway is a nervous breakdown waiting to happen. She has completely shielded herself from the outside world, but that doesn't stop a stalker in her attic from killing her.
Cats In The Cradle. Grissom and Catherine investigate the stabbing death of an 80-year-old woman who lived in a run-down house full of cats.
Anatomy Of A Lye. Grissom and Sara investigate when a man's body, which has been doused with lye, is found buried in a park.
Cross-Jurisdictions. Grissom and his crew handle their highest profile case to date when the city's former chief of detectives is slain execution-style in his house following a wild party.
The Hunger Artist. The CSIs investigate when the body of an unidentified young woman is discovered stuffed in an overturned shopping cart near a freeway underpass.
Assume Nothing. Two couples meet in a bar and one of the couples is murdered. When a second couple is murdered in a similar fashion the team suspects a pair of serial killers are on the loose.
All For Our Country. When the lead suspects in Grissom's serial killer case are murdered, Grissom suspects an inside job.
Homebodies. Grissom and Warrick get the case of an elderly woman found mummified in her closet. Sara and Nick arrive to investigate a breaking and entering to find a raped teen.
Feeling The Heat. During the latest heatwave in Las Vegas, with triple-digit temperatures, Gil and Catherine investigate a baby locked in a car.
Fur and Loathing. The team is introduced to the Furry side of Vegas when a man is found dead on the side of the road, dressed in a raccoon suit.
Jackpot. A severed head is shipped to Dr. Robbins from Jackpot, Nevada. Grissom goes to Jackpot to find the rest of the body and gets very little cooperation from the locals.
Invisible Evidence. Warrick's appearance at the preliminary hearing on a rape and murder case goes terribly wrong when the only piece of evidence is thrown out on a technicality.
After The Show. A suspect's infatuation with Catherine results in her taking over a high-profile case.
CSIenespanol.us: Perro come perro. En la noche de "Acción de Gracias," un hombre es encontrado muerto en un contenedor de basura detrás de un restaurante.
Aún con vida. El hijo de seis años de una madre viuda es secuestrado en un parque local.
Criaturas lobo. CSI investiga el asesinato de un hombre que estaba cubierto de pelo de la cabeza a los pies y recibió un disparo en el corazón con una bala de plata.
La niña de papá. El equipo de CSI entra en el mundo de los drogadictos y las metanfetaminas.
Besitos y adiós. Los CSI entran al mundo de la glamorosa Las Vegas.
Asesino. CSI investiga dos muertes, ambas vinculadas al mismo asesino.
Piratas del tercer Reich. Grissom hace equipo con Lady Heather.
Humo en el cielo. Se descubre un cuerpo metido en una chimenea prendida en una casa residencial.
Fetichismo. Una serie documental sobre crímenes sigue a los CSI durante las primeras 48 horas de una investigación.
Sospechoso inusual. Un juicio por asesinato de alto perfil cae en picada cuando dos hermanos confiesan el mismo crimen.
El hechizo. La ciencia choca con lo oculto cuando el equipo investiga el caso de una psíquica que predijo su propio asesinato.
Estrellas pasajeras. Los CSI entran al mundo de la música rap para investigar la muerte de tres adolescentes asesinados mientras trabajaban para raperos rivales.
Mamá odiada. Resolver el caso de un abogado defensor adinerado asesinado en la boda de su hijo, se ve comprometido cuando todas las pruebas son robadas junto con el auto de Nick.
La hora de tu muerte. La evidencia demuestra que las apariencias engañan en el caso de un jugador de alto riesgo y mujeriego, asesinado fuera de un casino después de una noche de juerga.

Evil Influence. In some cases, the transformation from everyday woman to brutal killer is activated by a man. A boyfriend or husband can become the focus of a deadly obsession.

Revenge. Crimes of revenge are usually single acts of passion. A brew of hatred and restitution boils over in a manic moment of fury. Once caught, revenge killers usually display remorse and atonement
Beyond Suspicion. A lovely lady with an innocent smile, kind eyes, a charming personality? No one would suspect a woman like that would murder. These women don’t look or behave like killers.
Blood for Money. These women would stop at nothing to get their hands on the cash they needed. From husbands to strangers to other people’s babies, they spilt blood for money.

Outlaws. While their sisters chose a life of sensible, suburban motherhood, these deadly women chose a life of crime. They lived with the thrills, the danger and the deadly consequences of being outla
Obsession. Deciphering what causes minds to corkscrew out of control is the complex work of the criminal profiler. Obsessions can take many forms: beauty, devotion, ego and power.
Under His Control. These are love stories with bleak, bloody endings. Blinded by desire, obsessed and malleable, some women fall into lethal relationships with dangerous, controlling men.

Deadly Delinquents. In the tormented mind of a young school girl, jealousy can turn to a murderous rage. These deadly girls turn on their own and kill their friends. This is the brutal world of deadly
Killer Kids. For many parents, their children's teen years can be one big headache. But when typical teenage rebellion turns into deadly rage, a parent's love may not be enough to save their life.

Breaking Point. Anger, fear and despair are basic human emotions. But when these emotions are coupled with a broken mind, a perfect storm is created. Teetering on the edge of unbalance, these women re
Deadly Women: Match Made For Murder

Match Made For Murder. When a woman wants more from her husband than he can give, marriage can be a dangerous union. For these deadly women, relationships mean nothing more than a match made for murde
Fatal Obsession. These deadly women were consumed by obsessions that overtook their minds and their lives. These women all had a fatal fixation.
Thrill Killers. This episode transports us into the teenage territory of Indiana pack leader Melinda Loveless, whose jealousy sparks a rampage that leads to the kidnap and torture of a 12-year-old.
Deadly Possessions. A grandmother caring for her grandchildren, a young girl in love with a boy, and a mother protecting her son are consumed with intense love. But when that love is threatened, they
Fatal Attraction. No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

The Deadly Assassin: Part Four. The Master makes his final bid to release the devastating power of the Time Lords.

The Invisible Enemy: Part Two. (2/4) As the Doctor's condition worsens, he tells Leela to take him to the Bi-Al Foundation.

TheAndyGriffithShow.us: The New Housekeeper. Andy's son, Opie, demands that their new housekeeper, Andy's aunt, be fired after the old one leaves to get married.
Lawman Barney. Deputy Barney Fife loses his self-confidence when two farmers ignore his warning.
Andy The Marriage Counselor. Andy tries to counsel the constantly bickering couple, Fred and Jennie Boone, with mixed results.
Andy And The Gentleman Crook. A nationally known con man becomes a hero to Aunt Bee, Opie and Barney when he is held for two days in the Mayberry jail.
Opie Loves Helen. Opie Taylor develops a crush on his teacher, who also happens to be his father's girlfriend.
Andy and Barney in the Big City. Andy and Barney visit the big city and help to catch a notorious jewel thief in the process.
Andy the Matchmaker. Andy and Ellie stage a hold-up at the drugstore so that Barney can impress Miss Rosemary with his heroics.
Wedding Bells for Aunt Bee. Aunt Bee begins dating the dry cleaner because she wants to give Andy space to pursue his own relationships.
Goodbye Sheriff Taylor. Andy goes to Raleigh for a job interview and chaos prevails in Mayberry with Barney Fife as acting sheriff.
Gomer the House Guest. Gossiping Gomer Pyle moves in with the sheriff when he loses his job and home at the filling station.
Barney's Physical. A campaign to fatten and stretch Barney Fife gets underway when it becomes apparent he doesn't match up to Civil Service physical requirements.
Briscoe Declares for Aunt Bee. Aunt Bee is the unwilling object of matrimony when mountaineer Briscoe Darling comes a'courting.
Barney and the Choir. Andy's diplomacy and engineering skills are required to help the Mayberry choir adjust to the recent addition of tone-deaf Barney Fife to the group.
Andy's English Valet. An English tourist works off his reckless driving fine by being a valet and chauffeur for Andy.
Andy on Trial. Andy is put on trial for his law enforcement practices when a Raleigh newspaper reporter writes a damaging article about the lawman.
Opie's Charity. Andy makes a judgment concerning his son, Opie, before hearing the boy's side of the story.
Aunt Bee's Invisible Beau. Aunt Bee invents a beau. When she's pressed for a name she names the butter and egg man who is married.
Mr. McBeevee. Andy fears Opie has an imaginary friend when he starts telling tall tales.
Sheriff Barney. A trial run as Sheriff of Mayberry convinces Barney that he is not quite ready to take over a similar job in a neighboring town.
Andy and the Woman Speeder. An attractive young woman, who has been given a speeding ticket by Andy, pleads not guilty and uses female guile.
The Luck of Newton Munroe. Comedian Don Rickles guest stars as Newton Monroe, an itinerant peddler who seems unable to do anything right.
The Perfect Female. Andy is too obvious in his efforts to find out if a young lady meets his expectations.
The Keeper of the Flame. Opie keeps a secret club oath even in the face of the serious accusation of burning down a barn.
TV or Not TV. Andy's reputation brings a proposal from a Hollywood writer that he star in a television series as a sheriff without a gun.
Back to Nature. Andy takes his son Opie and several of his pals on a camping trip. Barney and Gomer tag along to help out but only succeed in getting themselves lost in the woods.
Andy and the New Mayor. The new mayor in town is displeased with Andy's laid-back small-town approach to law enforcement.
The Bank Job. Barney Fife is convinced that Opie's piggy bank is safer than the Mayberry bank-and sets out to prove his point.
